access: Eight publicly displayed preview images downloaded from public listing image URLs and inspected visually. No account login, authenticated product interactions, or flow playback tested. No Mobbin connector available; browser access was unavailable in the prior attempt.
scope: Research and proposed NEAR dashboard design only. No product UI or payment behavior changes.

references.observed: Total spend occupies the main panel. A side column separates the budget amount, reset timing, token count and request count. Project and date filters remain above the panels.
references.apply: Place financial totals above the workflow and owner limits alongside it. Label token units and the exact budget scope; show available funds separately from spending authority.
references.boundary: This screenshot shows a monthly budget presentation. It does not establish a hard enforcement guarantee. AgentPay's implemented budget is cumulative and has no automatic monthly reset.
references.listingLabel: OpenAI Platform Web Budget Dashboard screen

references.screen: Trace log table with error rows
references.journey: Find the decision that needs attention
references.observed: A trace table keeps input, output, duration and call counts in aligned columns. Error rows receive a pale red background and an error icon; filters, search and a time range sit above the table.
references.apply: Add compact execution rows below the central workflow. Give DENY, ERROR and recovery-required events distinct text labels and icons. Selecting a row should reveal its rule, inputs and receipt evidence.
references.boundary: The row-to-evidence drawer is our proposal, supported separately by the earlier Front reference. A policy denial is an expected guarded outcome and must remain visually distinct from an execution failure.

references.journey: Trace agent calls to their funded session
references.observed: Filter chips identify date/time, assistant, session and chat. A dense table aligns conversation input/output, message count, cost and creation time.
references.apply: Use run/session identifiers to connect repeated paid API requests to one funded session. Show verified request count and extra payment transaction count in the session summary.
references.boundary: Vapi's cost column does not establish AgentPay's cost model. One AgentPay session covers multiple requests; do not invent a new payment or transaction hash for each request.

references.journey: Understand what an agent key can do
references.observed: The authorization card names the application, summarizes requested capabilities and resources, and presents separate Cancel and Authorize actions. A redirect destination is visible.
references.apply: Show a readable authority card: agent account, vault account, allowed methods, gas allowance and independent token limits. Keep owner capabilities and policy signer responsibility explicit.
references.boundary: This is an OAuth authorization screen. NEAR function-call keys use a different mechanism. Their gas allowance is not a USDC budget; the vault separately enforces token spending limits.

references.journey: Explain a limit before saving it
references.observed: A focused dialog states the recurring period and credits-per-month unit, adds projected-spend context, and separates a notification email field from the amount.
references.apply: If owner configuration receives a UI, show cumulative budget, maximum session deposit, maximum rate and maximum duration with explicit units. Describe contract enforcement separately from policy observations.
references.boundary: The source labels a target limit and notification behavior. Do not copy its monthly reset or suggest an alert is equivalent to preventing an onchain payment. Owner editing is proposed UI.

references.observed: Security history separates date/time, team member, event, source and IP address, with a visible date filter and an export action.
references.apply: In evidence details, label actor and authority: agent request, policy permit, owner recovery or provider claim. Display source event time and network beside the receipt.
references.boundary: The screenshot provides a layout pattern, not an immutable-log guarantee. Do not add IP data, export actions or actor attribution that the selected AgentPay artifact does not provide.

references.screen: Filtered budget list with no results
references.journey: Recover from an empty filtered view
references.observed: Budget search and filters sit above All, Active and Expired tabs. A no-results message includes a Reset all filters action.
references.apply: For execution filters, distinguish no matching events from no recorded run, loading failure and runner unavailable. Offer a reset action only when filters are responsible.
references.boundary: The empty list does not demonstrate populated budget rows, policy editing, or multi-agent provisioning. Keep this as an empty-state reference.

references.observed: A centered opt-in asks whether to receive email updates and offers Yes, No and Sign out actions.
references.apply: Exclude from wallet permissions and agent-authority design. Retain the candidate and reason so the curation is reviewable.
references.boundary: The category label 'Permission' describes marketing consent here; it provides no evidence of wallet access, spending approval or restricted-key setup.
